details: Led zero-downtime Rails 4→6.1 & Ruby 2.7→3.2 upgrades of a decade-old monolith using dual-boot (parallel CI lane, ALB canary on ECS), published precompiled Ruby builds for the team, and authored the internal upgrade runbook

Built EventPop's ticket resale marketplace from empty repo to production within 1 month (Rails, OAuth SSO, Omise payouts, Wise), and shipped LINE LIFF in-chat purchasing, Ticket Upgrade, and reserved-seating tooling
Owned payments: added Stripe as 2nd gateway alongside Omise: 10+ payment methods, installment plans, refunds, reconciliation, disputes, VAT & Thai e-tax
Cut every-page JS bundle by 48%, CI tasks from 425 to ~80, and organizer dashboards from 10-30s timeouts to sub-2s
Built anti-bot defenses for high-demand on-sales: checkout audit logs, order risk scoring, hCaptcha gating, rate limiting, honeypots, Cloudflare bot rules

Built the team's agentic dev platform (Claude Code skills, MCP server, parallel worktrees, preview envs), wrote the org adoption guide, and ran Thai release-note & PR health-check agents over ~150 PRs/month
Owned release engineering & DX: hardened deploy tooling (commit review, staging smoke-test gate) and built EDK, a reproducible VM dev environment for 3 services
Bridged engineering & business teams: Thai release comms, production escalation triage, postmortems, and self-service tooling (Support API/MCP, Venue Setup Wizard) that cut Support's dev dependency
Containerized, developed, and maintained Opn.Store infrastructure on EKS across multiple environments using Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm
Designed the Sales Promotion architecture with microservices & domain-driven design, and bootstrapped 4 e-commerce services for Opn.Store
Introduced modern web technologies to the team (SvelteJS, TailwindCSS, Vite) and drove technical-debt reduction through code reviews & pairing

workExperiences.company: EventPop (acquired by OPN TH in 2021, divested in 2023)
details: Designed and built core services (ticketing, seating, payments, fee calculation, billing, reporting, public APIs) in Ruby on Rails; sold 2M+ tickets in 6 years
Integrated payment providers (Omise, ThaiEPay, 123 by 2C2P, SCB-Easy, K-PayPlus, K-PaymentGateway) processing 1B+ THB, plus 3rd-party services (Kerry Express, DHL, Queue-It, Refund Protect, Skootar)
Pioneered DevOps practices (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD with CircleCI, GitHub Actions, Drone CI, ArgoCD, FluxCD, Terraform), keeping daily releases possible
Interviewed 50+ software engineers and designed technical interview questions & on-site coding challenges
Co-founded one of the first makerspaces in Bangkok; hosted 3D-printing, Arduino & IoT workshops (100+ participants) and Intel Galileo tutorials for Intel Thailand
Built hardware for clients & startups, including the smart door-lock system for Hubba (Bangkok's first co-working space), and served 50+ 3D-printing clients
